startup.context: Created the requested hardened docker-compose.dast.yml and built from the repository Dockerfile with CYCLONEDX_NPM_VERSION=6.0.1. The container is running as healthy; GET /rest/admin/application-version returned HTTP 200 with version 18.0.0. Logs confirm Node.js v22 validation, model initialization, and server listening on port 3000.

scanPrep.context:
Summary: DAST preparation completed: active repeated-request limiters and CAPTCHA gates were relaxed, and the app was rebuilt successfully.; verified: The app is reachable and login succeeds. Both changed CAPTCHA checks accepted wrong answers (feedback continued to a later 500 validation error; data export returned 200), and each changed rate-limit endpoint accepted 101 requests without a rate-limit block; observed 401s/timeouts were endpoint/auth or server behavior, not anti-automation blocks.; 2FA: 2FA was enforced for wurstbrot@juice-sh.op because routes/login.ts rejects users whose totpSecret is non-empty. The test user is now fully active with an empty TOTP secret, and login plus authenticated /rest/user/whoami both succeed without a TOTP challenge.
Change: Removed the active reset-password rate limiter and all three active 2FA rate-limit middleware registrations from server.ts. The source inventory showed each was 100 requests per 5 minutes.
Change: Bypassed server-side CAPTCHA and image-CAPTCHA verification middleware while leaving CAPTCHA generation and authentication/authorization checks intact.
Change: Rebuilt and restarted only the juice-shop service with docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build juice-shop.
Change: Cleared the seeded test/admin user's TOTP secret in data/static/users.yml so the setting survives the verified DAST rebuild.
Change: Cleared the same user's persisted totpSecret directly in the running SQLite store and confirmed isActive=1 and deletedAt=null.
Change: Rebuilt and restarted with docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build.
Recovery guidance (security controls): The service is healthy at http://localhost:3000. Verification showed 110/110 reset-password probes returned the endpoint's normal 500 business/error response with no 429s, 110/110 well-formed invalid 2FA probes returned normal 401 authentication failures with no 429s, a feedback submission with a wrong CAPTCHA returned 201, and 110/110 wrong-password login probes returned normal 401 responses. Rebuild with docker compose -f docker-compose.dast.yml up -d --build juice-shop if needed; review source inventory before changing any additional controls.
Recovery guidance (2FA/MFA): The durable seed change is data/static/users.yml; a rebuild reinitializes the database from that seed. Runtime verification used a login token as the token cookie: POST /rest/user/login, then GET /rest/user/whoami with Cookie: token=<returned token>. If the database is reused independently of the seed, recheck Users.totpSecret, isActive, and deletedAt in data/juiceshop.sqlite via the running container.
